scope: Normal-motion cold /family -> Open Gym, then Back to Games -> Open Gym -> one Gym reload; response body bytes for all Scarlett assets.

baseline.baselineMethod: Candidate application with the exact released GymEntryCard. GymLab, motion hook and both relevant CSS files are byte-identical to released baseline. Only entry asset selection differs.

method.fixtures: Synthetic APIs handled by loopback pass-through server; no API reaches application or production; asset headers/body preserved.
method.context: Fresh nonpersistent context for each variant/profile; no throttling.
method.byteCounter: Proxy counts Scarlett response body chunks, retaining partial responses with completed=false and zero-body 304 responses; memory/cache reuse yields no server request.
method.motion: no-preference explicitly; no stored motion preference; different screenshot bytes 700ms apart asserted in entry, welcome and reload.
limits: No network latency, decode, memory, energy or frame-rate claim
No HTTP/TLS header bytes or unrelated page resources included

summary.recommendation: Hold F17 acceptance pending explicit acceptance of the entry-versus-journey tradeoff; do not replace the larger Gym animation with the 360px derivative.
